title: NntpQueue drain not aligned to relay_queue explicit-match pattern
description: queue.rs drain_once uses 'while let Ok(Some(entry)) = dir.next_entry().await' (line 198). This commit updated relay_queue.rs to use explicit match Ok(Some)/Ok(None)/Err for the same loop pattern — precisely because the while-let silently drops errors. The NntpQueue was not aligned. The two queue implementations now differ in error handling posture for identical code structure. Rewrite NntpQueue drain_once read_dir loop to match relay_queue.rs pattern with warn! on Err and break.
